### B23. Version — Description · max 4000
<!-- from: docs/DONE_WORK.md, lib/l10n/app_en.arb about/onboarding, docs/STORE_PRIVACY.md; marketplace connection absent from functions/src -->
```text
Reseller Studio is the operating system for your reselling business. It follows one chain from end to end: source, purchase, inventory, list, sell, ship, profit, analyze — then source better.

TELLS YOU WHAT NEEDS ATTENTION TODAY
Home opens on the work, not on a dashboard: orders to ship, offers waiting, payouts still to record, items not listed anywhere, and inventory that has sat too long.

FAST INTAKE
Add an item with nothing but a title. Scan a barcode, snap a photo, or run an intake session for a whole haul. Cost, category and location attach when you have them, not before.

REAL PROFIT, NEVER AN ESTIMATE
Profit, margin and ROI are worked out from what you actually paid and what the platform actually paid you. Fees are measured from your payout, never guessed from a published rate — and when a figure is unknown, it shows a dash instead of a zero.

ORDERS AND SHIPPING
Record a sale with the platform's order number, ship it, settle it, handle returns and refunds, and chase the payouts that are late. Import a payout report you downloaded from your marketplace.

SOURCING THAT PAYS FOR ITSELF
Track sources, purchases and buying trips. Split a receipt across the items on it, rank your sources by ROI, and use the buy calculator before you pay.

DROPSHIPPING TOO
List a supplier's product, sell it, order it from the supplier and track it to the buyer — with the profit measured from what the supplier actually charged. Keep a primary and a backup supplier per item.

BULK BY DEFAULT
List, reprice, mark live, pause, end and archive many items at once, or apply your pricing rules to a whole selection.

ANALYTICS AND TAX
Sales, profit, inventory, marketplace, category and source views, plus a dropship view. US and UK tax summaries, mileage, and a one-action tax pack for your accountant.

NO ACCOUNT NEEDED
Start straight away: without an account your records stay on this device. Sign in with Apple or Google when you want them backed up, on another device, or shared with your team.

WORKS WITH YOUR TEAM
Run several businesses under one account, invite teammates and set their roles.

IN SEVEN LANGUAGES
English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Chinese and Vietnamese.

PREMIUM
Everything is free except exports. Premium unlocks every CSV export and the tax pack.

Reseller Studio does not connect to your marketplace accounts, does not sell your data and does not use it for advertising.

Reseller Studio Premium is available as a monthly or yearly auto-renewing subscription, or as a one-time lifetime purchase, at the price shown in the app. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation. A subscription renews automatically unless turned off at least 24 hours before the period ends; manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings. Lifetime never renews.
Privacy Policy: TODO(owner) privacy URL
Terms of Use (EULA): TODO(owner) terms URL, or https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
```

### B31. App Review — Notes · max 4000
<!-- from: CLAUDE.md hard rules 1 and 10, docs/DONE_WORK.md, lib/l10n/app_en.arb -->
```text
The app works without an account: a signed-out user's records stay on the device. The only ways to sign in are Sign in with Apple and Google Sign-In, offered from More → General and from the banner on Home. Account deletion is in More → General → Delete account.

Everything is free except exports. The paywall opens from More → General → Subscription and from the Go Premium banner on Home; it shows each plan's title, length and price with the Privacy Policy and Terms of Use links. The description carries the same links.

The app does not connect to any marketplace account. Payout reports are imported from a file the seller downloads.
```

### E3. Project description · max 600
<!-- from: docs/DONE_WORK.md, pubspec.yaml, CLAUDE.md tech stack -->
```text
A seller operating system for resellers and dropshippers. It opens on what needs attention today, adds an item with just a title, runs bulk actions across many items, and measures real profit from what each platform actually paid — never an estimate. Works without an account on a local Drift database; signing in moves the records to Firestore with team roles. Seven languages, US and UK tax summaries. Built with Flutter, Riverpod, Drift, Firebase (Auth, Firestore, Storage, Cloud Functions) and RevenueCat.
```
